title: Address Truth — nothing shows a position it does not know
prerequisite: M55 and M61 completion bars met — re-audited by G1 on every run through the persisted closure records
laneDiscipline: D-7: script/m62/*, script/m26/*, script/lib/*, validation/m62/*, docs/m62/* plus the IDE-lane sources this milestone owns (src/lsp/*, src/intelligence/*, src/mcp/tool-handlers.ts); co-agent lanes (M14/M37/M58/M59/M60) are read-only

issues.scope: the M62 ledger; the bar re-audit that re-executes A1/A2/A3/D1 on every run; the chain wiring audit; the lane's prerequisites (M55 + M61 bars)
acceptanceCriteria: gate exits 0 only on a fully verified ledger; a hollow closure, a removed issue, a mis-ordered group, a lane escape, a tampered record, an unwired gate and a hand-edited count each FAIL (proven by in-memory negatives)
this run's own ledger entry is written from measurements and validated whole, never asserted
the lane's own bars (M55 X1, M61 X1) are re-audited here on every run
closureRequirements: G1 evidence (verified, sealed) at the closing HEAD
the bar re-audit reports A1/A2/A3/D1 green in the same run
every M62 gate command present in npm run verify and verify:fast

issues.scope: the address owner: CallSiteAddress contract, pure derivation, one formatter, the 0-based projection
acceptanceCriteria: > 0 -> call-site; 0 -> unknown (legacy); null/undefined -> unknown (not-stored); negative/fractional/NaN/Infinity -> unknown (unusable), and a substitute is produced only as a labeled declaration for the store's declared unknown states
a bare file:line is producible only for kind call-site; addressLine0 returns a line only for a call site and agrees with the position owner
the mutation suite catches every planted defect, including the present-vs-absent class the fixture exposed
closureRequirements: validation/m62/results/A1.json verified at the closing HEAD with realFailed 0 and declared mutant totals
the contract change is compile-clean with every consumer narrowed

issues.scope: consumer adoption: the engine, the hub payload, bb_graph, the webview mirror and the declared kinds; the permanence lint
acceptanceCriteria: no surface shows an unlabeled substitute or a fabricated position; the engine has no positional fallback
the hub payload and the bb_graph payload serve the engine's addresses (differential); the webview declares the address kinds it shows
the permanence lint fails on a planted display-side read of the raw stored line
closureRequirements: validation/m62/results/A2.json verified at the closing HEAD with realFailed 0
the lane's IDE gates re-earned at the closing HEAD (m24/m26/m42/m44/m55 suites)

issues.scope: the generated address doc and the M59 arrival hook (three store states, the no-code-change upgrade, multiplicity, declared coverage)

the arrival hook proves on a real index that a real line is an exact call site, both unknown stores are declared, the unusable store is never substituted, and a re-index upgrade needs no consumer change
per-language real-line coverage is declared as M59's lane, not claimed here
closureRequirements: validation/m62/results/A3.json and D1.json verified at the closing HEAD
the generated doc committed and byte-identical at the closing HEAD
